item.description:
Improved reading source management
- Navigation shows only connected reading sources. - All appears only when two or more sources are connected. - Disconnect Apple Books, Kindle or Readeck directly from Settings. - Reconnect Apple Books and Kindle or edit Readeck connection details. - Confirmation before disconnecting a source. - Connection preferences persist across app restarts. - Original highlights and exported Markdown files remain untouched.

Settings improvements
- Seamless Settings title bar matching the selected appearance. - Removed the visual divider beneath the title bar. - Updated the privacy footer to cover all reading sources. - Preserved native window controls and behavior.

## What's new
- Import article highlights directly from Readeck. - Connect securely using your server URL and API token. - Browse imported Readeck highlights offline. - Reload and export Readeck independently. - Open original articles directly from Sage. - Readeck appears in navigation only when connected. - Redesigned onboarding with animated connection buttons. - Clearer connection instructions for each reading source. - Improved Apple Books folder selection.
Known limitations: - Readeck connections currently require HTTPS. - Extended Readeck pagination and export edge cases require further testing. - Larger Kindle libraries requiring additional pagination are not yet supported. - Permanent Apple Books highlight deletion remains unavailable.

Sage Highlights 0.3.0
- Import Kindle highlights and notes alongside Apple Books. - Browse, refresh and export each reading source independently. - Keep imported Kindle highlights available offline. - Cancel Kindle imports without replacing the existing library. - Enjoy redesigned Settings, Liquid Glass navigation and improved reading zoom. - Improved sidebar layout and export controls.
Known limitations: - Kindle libraries requiring additional pagination are not yet supported. - Some highlights may be unavailable through Amazon Kindle Notebook. - Permanent Apple Books highlight deletion is currently unavailable.

Sage Highlights 0.2.2
- Simpler Apple Books onboarding - Connect directly to the Apple Books data folder - Remember the Apple Books connection between launches - Full Disk Access is now a fallback rather than the default - Improved Apple Books access error reporting - First export folder picker opens in Documents - Previously selected export destinations remain remembered
Permanent highlight deletion under Hardened Runtime remains unverified.

Sage Highlights 0.2.1
- Added Sparkle automatic updates - Added Check for Updates in the application menu - Enabled background update checks - Enabled automatic installation of future updates - Preserved existing Apple Books and Markdown functionality
The Apple Books permanent deletion helper has not been functionally verified under Hardened Runtime.
